# `csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls`

When a chain breaks, leave the dot at the end of the preceding line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").Append("World").Append("!").ToString();
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls = true`

```ini
csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls = true
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls = false`

```ini
csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
